verdict.rationale: Elicit's Systematic Reviews workflow explicitly walks through setup, search/gather, title-abstract screening, full-text screening, and data extraction via customizable columns applied consistently across all papers, with exportable screening/extraction tables — directly matching the story of systematic screening+extraction across many papers with consistent criteria (elicit-docs-1, elicit-docs-22, elicit-docs-45, elicit-docs-18, elicit-docs-19, elicit-docs-38, elicit-docs-39). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation specifically of the systematic-review screening-extraction accuracy (community evidence available only discusses general search/chat accuracy issues, not the systematic review pipeline itself), and no third-party audit of consistency across large paper sets.
